scope: Selected managed build effects (I05–I10). Excludes raw, diagnostic materialization, watch progress and non-selected labels.

stateVariables.view: Manager/provider/graph/input identity changes abstracted to a version.
stateVariables.pc: Each target has its own next stage; completed effects are historical.
stateVariables.held: One live target/stage permit, releases on callback return.
stateVariables.effect: Most recent protected effect, its basis and identity at the boundary.

initialState: Two new targets at mutation; selectable source policy, no permit.
assumptions: Two-edge chain, applying the middle source label denies its provider edge. The independent target has no such label. Output-copy is a separate stage in the output workflow, not part of every build.

safety.DeniedHasNoEffect: No effect of a forbidden target at the event view.
safety.ScopedEffect: Issued identity and stage match the actual effect.
safety.NoIndependentCompletion: Reachability control for independent completion despite refusal.
safety.NoLateCopyRefusal: Reachability control for refusing copy after legal launch.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 2 targets, 1 intermediate, 1 provider, 1–2 view changes, one callback at a time.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Mutants model integration errors. Cover profiles intentionally negate observable legal states.
empiricalVerification: Run evidence/managed-cache/replay.mjs; execution-admission, execution-input-handoff and checker/admission-denied-reference.
